name: How much does drywall texture repair typically cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does drywall texture repair typically cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Drywall texture repair costs depend on patch size, ceiling height, texture type, and whether underlying drywall damage or framing needs reinforcement first. A small isolated repair typically costs less than resolving water-damaged ceilings or blending custom hand-troweled plaster textures. Because proper blending requires multiple steps—patching, texturing, priming, and topcoat painting—combining texture repairs with scheduled interior painting or handyman punch-list items often reduces your overall labor expense compared to booking standalone patch visits.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cost depends on patch dimensions, texture type, and repair depth. Combining patching with interior painting or wider finish work helps keep total labor costs down.
